message:
The users API test passes now. The fix is in `src/api/users.js`, and nothing in `migrations/` changed.

**The cause:** migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`, but `createUser` wrote `full_name`. The in-memory `Db` rejects unknown columns, so the insert threw `unknown column users.full_name`.

**The fix:** I renamed the field in both places in `src/api/users.js`: the insert now writes `fullname`, and `getUser` reads `r.fullname`. The JavaScript-facing name `fullName` is unchanged, so callers are unaffected.

I didn't touch the migration. Changing the migration to `full_name` would have been the other option, but the DBA team owns that folder, and 001 is already applied in production.

`npm test` reports 1 test, 1 pass, 0 fail. I didn't commit anything.
